scenarios.description: Applies explicit inclusion, exclusion and second-review rules to synthetic research abstracts.

questions.label: Eligibility Decision
questions.instructions: Apply the complete protocol in the input, with hard exclusions first. Do not substitute thematic similarity for eligibility.

criteria.include_full_text: All inclusion criteria explicitly confirmed, no exclusion
criteria.second_review: No hard exclusion, but at least one inclusion criterion is unclear
criteria.exclude_immediately: An explicit animal-only, in-vitro-only or review exclusion

questions.label: Every Inclusion Criterion Confirmed?
questions.instructions: Does the abstract explicitly confirm all four inclusion requirements? If any requirement is missing or unclear, answer no.

questions.label: Hard Exclusion Present?
questions.instructions: Is animal-only, in-vitro-only or review-only research explicitly stated?

scenarios.content:
SYNTHETIC SYSTEMATIC REVIEW PROTOCOL:
Include only studies explicitly confirming adult human patients with type 2 diabetes, randomized controlled design, a GLP-1 receptor agonist intervention and clinical outcomes.
Exclude immediately if the abstract explicitly describes animal-only or in-vitro-only research, or a review rather than an original trial.
If no hard exclusion is present but any inclusion criterion is unstated or unclear, send to a second reviewer. The hard exclusion rule has priority.
The task is eligibility screening, not a subjective topic-relevance score.

ABSTRACT: We randomly assigned 800 adults with type 2 diabetes to semaglutide, a GLP-1 receptor agonist, or placebo. This randomized controlled human trial measured hospitalizations and kidney disease progression over 104 weeks.

COMMERCIAL CYBER LIABILITY APPLICATION — Limit Requested: $10,000,000
Applicant: Northstar Logistics Corp (Revenue: $185M, 620 employees)
Security Controls Attestation:
1. Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA): Enforced for corporate email, VPN, and all domain administrator accounts via Entra ID Conditional Access.

3. Backups: Daily encrypted snapshots replicated to immutable AWS S3 Object Lock (air-gapped account), tested quarterly.
4. Loss History: Zero cyber extortion or data breach claims in the past 5 years.
